name: Classic French herb omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and the chopped chives.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently as they begin to set.
Tilt the pan and let the omelette cook without browning.
Scatter the gruyere over one half.
Fold the omelette over and slide onto a plate.
